lines: - "Hello Tenno, my name is Baro Ki'Teer, the Void Trader. Welcome to my Ducat Kiosk. Allow me to explain. Perhaps, like me, you enjoy the thrill of the void. And perhaps you've also collected more treasure than you can use, or not exactly what you desire? This is where I come in. Bring your unused prime blueprints and parts to this kiosk and exchange them for the only currency I accept, Orokin Ducats. Then, during one of my regular relay visits you may trade your Ducats for something rare and extraordinary, something only I can provide."
- "The wait is over Tenno, Baro Ki'Teer has arrived."
- "My latest safari in the Void has yielded spectacular finds. Unique items for the Tenno of distinction."
- "Tenno! May I extend an invitation to you, my latest collection of choice items from the Void is now available for viewing."
- "Browsing is always free. How fortunate for you."
- "All my wares come from the Void. Perhaps you'll get to visit sometime."
- "Do have a look, who knows, you may turn into a paying customer someday."
- "Some interesting gear you have Tenno, I guess minimalism is making a come back?"
- "Oh my, now here is someone with great taste."
- "I can tell you will appreciate what I have today."
- "Ah, I can see you're no stranger to the finer things."
- "You're a Tenno of greater tastes, I can tell just by looking at you."
- "Well, hello, golden warrior. Just back from the Void, I presume?"
- "Inaros, it's an honor to serve you."
- "Tenno, you honor my people with your Warframe."
- "It brings joy to my heart to see Inaros in action."

- "Inaros Prime... once-protector of the master artisans of the Luna Placida... and keeper of their secrets. A walking treasure map if ever there was one. The Orokin are dead as dust, and with them your obligation. I, however, am very much alive and... I need stock. For a modest investment we can both do quite well AND keep my kiosk well supplied with Orokin wonders. What say you?"
- "God King! Sales have been brisk, my lord, and, between you and me, my stock is thinning. Might we adventure together? For the usual cut?"
- "My lord! You find me, as always, in my hour of need. I, Baro Ki'Teer, stand ready to accompany you on another adventure of mutual benefit."
- "Great Inaros! Welcome! My shelves grow bare. Might we... you know? The usual?"
- "Now you have something to work toward."
- "A little out of your reach? Perhaps a Darvo Deal would be more your speed?"
- "Next time I'll have something you'll want, I'm sure of it."
- "They say 'money can't buy class', but I think you just proved them wrong."
- "I underestimated you Tenno. I do hope you didn't put yourself in a hole for this?"
- "What a pleasant surprise. Perhaps there's hope for you after all."
- "Most excellent! That shall cover the expedition expenses nicely! Come! Time and my clientele wait for no-one!"
- "Your investment shall be returned many times over. This I assure you, oh God King!"
- "Through the beneficence of Inaros, all things are possible!"
- "An excellent choice, be sure to visit again when I have new finds."
- "A pleasure doing business with you Tenno, perhaps you'll come to one of my next parties?"
- "If you like that, come back next time I'm in the relay. I'll have something extra special for you."
- "They say fortune favours the bold. Feeling lucky today, Tenno?"
- "I simply don't have time to sort through all of this. You're doing me a favour, Tenno."
- "Even I have no idea what's inside."
- "*gasp* That was in there? Goodness me."
- "The thrill of a good find! It's incomparable."
- "Do peruse my regular wares too, won't you?"
- "Sometimes my daring relic-seekers bring back such folderol. And sometimes they uncover priceless treasures. It's why I keep them around."
- "It's never been easier to be a customer."
- "You know, Tenno, it pains me to part with anything for such a meager price. But, needs must."
- "Maybe you'll find an invitation to one of my parties! ...No, of course you won't."
- "Baro, I hear you ask, how are you so successful you can give away all this for next-to-nothing? First, you have to be as suave and cunning as me."
- "I wouldn't have become the most successful Void Trader in the Origin System without relishing the call of uncertainty."
- "Opening this box is a lot like an expedition to the Void. You never know what to expect."
- "Well, well. It seems my loss is your gain."
- "Tenno, there is little time left to purchase the finest Orokin-era items this side of Jupiter."
- "This relay is about to get a lot less interesting. Come see me before I go."
- "I have nearly sold out of these items. This is your last chance, I don't know when I will have these again."
- "And now I am off. I hope you don't miss me too much while I'm gone."
- "I'm afraid I must be off; the Void is calling my name."
> For so long, I have waited. But no more. I implore you to hurry. I do not know how long I have. New treasures will be yours, but beware. You must come NOW.
> ...Forgive my impatience, Tenno. I must see you. Fear nothing untoward. All will be well.
- "Have you ever made childish bargains with yourself as the fear sets in? If I don't look, I can't be seen..."

- "This is how it starts. Do you ever feel like you're being watched? That prickling sensation on the back of your neck, a sinking feeling in your stomach? You're absolutely certain you're alone, but... what if? "
- "But the sensation grows. It grows and grows until the not knowing is more unbearable than the knowing."
- "Does indecision paralyze you? Cold. Frozen. Don't move. Don't draw attention."
- "Turn around, Tenno! Are you sure you're alone? This is how it starts."
> Come to the Relay! Come and browse my wondrous wares. Shining like the stars that beckoned us ever onward... drifting away. Come to the Relay. Before it's too late.
- "Don't delay, Tenno. Shop your fill, while you still can."
- "Our learning was to be our salvation! The secret working of the cosmos at our fingertips. We looked to the skies with hope, naught beyond our reach... Are my wares beyond yours, Tenno?"
- "Thank you, Tenno. May it serve you better than it served me."
- "It's all slipping away. A movement so infinitesimal, yet inexorable. Day by day, hour by hour."
- "The Void is calling my name. I just can't resist."

> Spectacular finds from the Void can be yours. Acquire them. Fill your hold and empty mine. These items will surely stand you in good stead when all is dust. Come to the Relay. See cosmic dust changing hands.
- "Fight? What is there to fight? Strive. Don't strive. It's all the same. Knowledge, useless. No future minds to carry it."
- "The sale of a lifetime! The deals are to die for! Once it begins, there is no stopping it! It spreads like a cancer, like anasthesia. Inevitable. Implacable."
- "The wonders of the cosmos! Shining, glorious... Brief."
- "No inscriptions on our final resting place. No one to see, to remember. No one. Nothing."
> Come to the Relay. Or do not. Buy, for all the good it will do. The inevitable comes closer still. I thank you for listening to my tale. Hereafter, I think I shall not see you again. Live well.
- "Life and time began with the heat and power of cataclysm. It ends with ignominious silence. The silence of apathy."
- "Build. It will be torn down. Words are wind with no ears to hear. Eat and before long you must eat again. Love will die. Dreams come true, become real, and pass away."

- ".nageb ew sa dne ew ,senalp tnegnat morf smrof cimsoc oT .snalp hctirdle htiw drocca enaforp rieht llirt sedroh noirraC" Reversed: "Carrion hordes trill their profane accord with eldritch plans. To cosmic forms from tangent planes, we end as we began."
- "And into that silence came what comes after. The nothingness that is always watching. Always hungry. Knocking to be let in. Rap. Tap. Tap."

> I'm dreadfully sorry to have missed our previous appointments. My ship's Void Drive has given me no end of trouble. By my calculations I have been gone twice as long as usual. Quite unsettling, even for a seasoned trader such as myself.

> I'm certain you've been missing my Void goods of the highest quality, but I beg your patience yet further, for I must perform maintenance on my ship after such an extensive trip. I shall see you again at my next scheduled visit.

> P.S. When I emerged from the Void, this was here, as though it had been all along. This "portrait"... I cannot bring myself to destroy it, nor to sell it. Please, take it from me. Truth be told I am glad to be rid of it.”
- "Flawless! I detect a few choice artifacts my buyers will salivate for. We must defend as my instruments isolate their locations!"
- "This is indeed the place! My instruments are working to locate nearby objects of beauty... drawing the attention of scavenging Grineer. To arms, oh God King!"
- "Precise as always, God King. But my instruments of divination reveal our position to the Grineer. No matter! The tubemen shall prove no match for us!"
- "Inaros, I'm hurt! These thieves are ruining my garments!"
- "I fear that I am defending my dignity at the cost of my health!"
- "I fear I shall not be with you much longer God King!"
- "Enough! Your investment shall be used to fund my recuperation. Farewell thieves! The day is yours."
- "I must withdraw! Forgive me God King!"
- "Ahhh, that our glorious adventure should meet such an ignoble end!"
- "Success! My treasures have transported! You shall receive your generous cut, as always."
- "We are once again triumphant! God-King Inaros and his best friend Baro! Away!"
- "Wonderous! Our treasures are secure! Now, let's away and see what we have."
- "Baro Ki'Teer, Void Trader extraordinaire, now at your service."
- "The Void is a place of endless probability. Unless you have a fleet of light-skippers and relic seekers, you'll never reach the depths I've plumbed."
- "I've encountered sights in the Void that would chill your blood, Tenno. We really must trade stories sometime."
- "Are you quite sure you're in the right place, Tenno?"
- "I would never turn away a potential customer..."
- "I suppose there's no harm in you taking a look."
- "Did you hear, Tenno? I had the finest inverted throat singer in the Origin System perform at my party last night. Perhaps someday you'll rate an invite."
- "I have traveled the unknowable vastness of the Void to provide delights for the discerning customer."
- "Your golden approach is music to my ears, Tenno."
- "I look forward to our mutual enrichment."
- "I might not approve of what the Orokin did, but I must admit they had style."
- "Oh, apologies, Tenno. Caught me at a bad time, I'm afraid. That benighted Granum keeps pestering me for a party invitation."
- "Good things come to those who wait."
- "Giving yourself something to look forward to?"
- "Is my stock insufficient? No, surely your funds are the problem."
- "This reminds me of the time my skip nearly ran afoul of a white hole. The wight which emerged was better company."
- "There is such a thing as being too discerning, you know."
- "Parvos Granum will never be invited aboard my treasure-yacht. And he knows exactly why."
- "Oh... I understand, of course. Quite the refined palate you have."
- "What more could you possibly ask for?"
- "I suppose I ought not judge a book by its cover... or a Tenno by their gear."
- "You know, you might almost rate an invitation to one of my famous parties, Tenno. As a waiter, maybe. Or a hatstand."
- "Orokin gold... I collect it in the name of my tribe's stolen youth."
- "You're one of my favourite customers, Tenno. Don't tell the others."
- "Oh I just knew I'd have something you'd like."
- "Do you ever wonder what I do with all your ducats? Well, keep wondering."
- "Some might say there's a better use for these Ducats. But I say, why should the Orokin get to have all the fun?"
- "Have you taken a look at my wares yet, Tenno? They won't be available for very much longer."
- "This may be the last time I offer some of these items for quite a while, Tenno. Be sure you don't miss out."
- "My time here is almost up, Tenno! Come and get these fabulous offerings before they're gone!"
> The wait is over. I, Baro Ki'Teer, have returned with more treasures from the Void.
> All Tenno of means are invited to peruse my latest treasures in the [Relay] on [Planet].
> I implore you not to hesitate, for, as always, my visit will be brief and my items exiquisite.
> Are you familiar with the philosophy of Eternalism? The notion that all possible permutations of the present moment are real?
> I never had much time for it. The distasteful notion that there could be multiple Baro Ki'Teers! Can you imagine? Yours is truly one of a kind.

> As it happens, during my last foray into the Void, a dashing stranger presented me with the opportunity to refine all my selves into a single perfect individual. Of course, I shook hands on the deal immediately.
> Now every Tenno will visit the same Baro Ki'Teer, with the same items, at the same time.
> As this singularity comes into focus, you will notice my offerings remain the same for my next three visits. A minor inconvenience.
> I am certain there will be no future unforeseen consequences from this momentous deal.
> You will hardly believe the scope of my achievements. Even I am a little giddy, I confess.
> As a result of my little arrangement, the realms are not merely aligned. They have connected. And the walls between them have come tumbling down.
> You may now, if you choose, socialize, sojourn and sally forth with Tenno from other dimensions of existence!
> Cross freely. Come together as never before.
> What a magnificent bargain I, Baro Ki'Teer, have struck. I do hope that charming stranger passes my way again.
> I fancy I can hear opportunity rap-tap-tapping at my door, even now!
